# 💬 Welcome to railhq.io Discussions!

This is the place to connect with the railhq.io community.

## 📚 Categories

### 💬 General
General discussion about railhq.io, model railways, and anything related.

### 💡 Ideas
Share your ideas for new features or improvements.

### ❓ Q&A
Ask questions and get help from the community.

### 🎉 Show and Tell
Share your model railway setup, track plans, or how you use railhq.io!

### 📢 Announcements
Important updates and announcements from the maintainers.
